description: Switch thrown under a train running facing through it (#289 review 2b): as eu07_td_switch_thrown_facing_head, but zwr01 is thrown to track 1 when the locomotive has left the switch for track 2 (event of tor2p, set off by its rear axle), with the coaches still before and on the switch. The axles on the switch keep their way (track 2), those that come to the points after the throw take track 1: the second coach runs with its front bogie on the way to track 2 and its rear one on the way to track 1, and physics.derailment monitor tells in the log that it derails once its bogies turn under it more than in the tightest curve it is built for (Rmin=80 of its definition). The AI stops before the exit signal of track 2.

trainsets: node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c1 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 3 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c2 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 3 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_c3 dynamic pkp\bdhpumn_v3 bdhpumn_50512608068-6 BDHPUMN_TAPICERKA_1 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
vars.route: node -1 0 autotest_route_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1034 keyctrl01 end
